newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - naphtha gains, gas oil dips.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - naphtha gains, gas oil dips.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Monday, with naphtha up and gas oil easier, traders said.
Gas oil slid around $7 a tonne on easier futures. French demand lifted heating oil cargo premiums. Barges were inactive.
Naphtha bounced with crude's strength and a bid from one end-user for Algerian or Egyptian material by month's end month.
Gasoline ended steady as hefty arbitrage deals the last two weeks offset weak local demand.
High sulphur fuel oil weakened again with inventory levels in ARA seen high. High sulphur cargoes traded at $101 cif NWE.
